search_reuse_mapping.rule: Same support bytes and seed; B0, unit1, tau0, ebar0 and all other settings fixed by protocol.

replay_optimization_validation.timing_scope: Same complete pilotseed0 outputs and frozen data. Original ran with sixparallelCPUaudits; optimized ran during fourGPUworkers. This is observed walltime,not a controlled equal-loadthroughput comparison.
replay_optimization_validation.root_cause: The original lazy NPZ noise object decompressed its full arrays on every row. The optimized replay loads each array once, marks it read-only, verifies unchanged bytes, and reuses exact left-to-right mask sums.

audit_bootstrap_validation.scope: Audit-only reformulation, same RNG row/puzzle draws and exact integer totals; no training or search changes.
